Trace, implement and test: LCP 52. 二叉搜索树染色

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(NULL), right(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    int getNumber(TreeNode* root, vector<vector<int>>& ops) {
        set<int> ts;
        function<void(TreeNode*)> dfs = [&](TreeNode* root) {
            if (root == nullptr) {
                return;
            }
            ts.insert(root->val);
            dfs(root->left);
            dfs(root->right);
        };
        dfs(root);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = ops.size() - 1; ~i; --i) {
            int t = ops[i][0];
            int x = ops[i][1], y = ops[i][2];
            auto it = ts.lower_bound(x);
            while (it != ts.end() && *it <= y) {
                ts.erase(it++);
                ans += t;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
